description: Fork of exp475 (1.4962). SINGLE change: backward_mode='soft'→'soft_winner'. Scaled-hard forward: out = softmax(ts/T_sel)[winner] * W[winner]. Picks argmax row like hard forward, but multiplies the winner's weights by its softmax coefficient (scalar in (1/K,1] per table). Single-row inference (same bandwidth as soft/ste), deterministic forward (train==eval), but the coeff is a differentiable confidence gate giving an x-gradient path through the selection scores. Hypothesis: the smooth confidence gate gives a richer gradient than pure-STE argmax without the inference cost of full soft mixture (exp444).
